race.comment: Tricky to assess with a field of debutants engaged. DENALI (9) perhaps has the most persuasive debut profile, combining a kind barrier, and hailing from the Scott Cooper yard that has been enjoying recent juvenile success. Her Better Than Ready pedigree also fits a sharp 1000m assignment. BAIRUKU (1) looks the main danger, with Spirit Of Boom speed in the pedigree and a useful family pointer through Creativity Miss, a Doomben winner who placed on debut. MR STRONG (5) gains leading hoop Ryan Wiggins and strips fitter for a recent Cairns trial. Have to pay attention to the market. ROWEINER'S MAGIC (6) is a Sidestep gelding on debut for the Kenning yard that has come along well at the trials and is another that warrants a close market watch. Fellow debutant BOOGIE ON BY (8) is also in the mix.
